param: B The constant influx rate of the human hosts.
μₕ The natural death rate of the human hosts.
μᵥ The natural death rate of the mosquitoes.
βₕ(a) The age-specific transmission rate from infected mosquitoes to susceptible hosts.
βᵥ(a) The age-specific transmission rate from infectious hosts to susceptible mosquitoes.
k(a) The age-specific rate at which exposed humans become infectious (inverse of latent period).
ρ The probability of exposed hosts transferring to the symptomatic infectious class.
γ₁(a) The age-specific recovery rate of symptomatic infectious hosts.
γ₂(a) The age-specific recovery rate of asymptomatic infectious hosts.
σ The factor characterizing the intensity of reinfection of asymptomatic individuals and their relative transmissibility.
Nₕ* The total human population at the disease-free equilibrium.
rate_E_to_I Progression rate from Exposed to Symptomatic Infectious.
rate_E_to_A Progression rate from Exposed to Asymptomatic Infectious.
contact_rate_h_freq Frequency-dependent contact rate for primary human infection from mosquitoes.
contact_rate_reinfect_freq Frequency-dependent contact rate for reinfection of asymptomatic humans.
contact_rate_v_symp_freq Frequency-dependent contact rate for mosquito infection from symptomatic humans.
contact_rate_v_asymp_freq Frequency-dependent contact rate for mosquito infection from asymptomatic humans.
